_readme: THE list of dashboard pages. The top nav, the SEO sub-tabs and the homepage all read this file;
add a page here (one entry) and it appears everywhere it should. tests/test_route_registry.py
checks every live slug resolves to a real page.
slug: path on dashboard.agenticaiautomation.co (with trailing slash; ?query/#hash allowed).
server: true = served by the API through nginx (Backlink Ops, Invoices), not a Next.js page.
roles: 'all' or a list of dashboard roles (owner, admin, seo, seo_lead, writer, viewer).
group: SEO | Content | Team | Finance | Admin.  status: live | hidden (deep page, not listed) | planned | removed.
nav: in the top bar.  tab: position in the SEO Operations sub-tabs.  pin: position in the homepage's top "Your desks" row.  requires: only shown when that /api/tasks/status flag is on.
